groups.market_hint: If the bill progresses further in parliament, it may trigger a sovereign risk premium spike and subsequent capital outflows in Q3 2026.
groups.R_reason: Passage of legislation is recorded clearly by the parliament and executive signing.
groups.S_reason: DPR RI and State Secretariat (Setneg) are definitive official sources.
groups.T_reason: Fixed deadline of December 31, 2026, aligning with the end of the legislative year.
groups.U_reason: Highly uncertain; political pressure to pass it exists, but heavy backlash from financial markets may delay it.
groups.H_reason: Significant coverage by local financial press like Bisnis Indonesia, Kontan, and international agencies.
